No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a human, JEN (30s), wades into the ocean, her eyes scanning the water for signs of life. Suddenly, she spots a fish, FINLEY (a sleek, silver fish), swimming near the surface. She reaches out a hand, and Finley is sucked into her grasp.

JEN
(excitedly)
Oh, look at you! You're so beautiful!

Finley struggles and squirms in Jen's hand, but she holds tight. Jen pulls Finley out of the water and onto the beach, where Finley lies flailing on the sand.

JEN
(curiously)
What's wrong, little guy? You're not used to being out of the water, are you?

Finley looks up at Jen with a mixture of fear and confusion. Jen holds him up to the sky, and Finley's gaze follows the sun as it begins to darken.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
The sky is... changing. The light is... shifting. What sorcery is this?

Jen holds Finley up to the sky, and the fish's eyes widen in terror as the sun's corona begins to appear.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(terrified)
It's... it's a... a... (gulps) a gateway to... to... (stammers) to... the void!

Jen's eyes light up with excitement, but Finley's gaze is fixed on the eclipse.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I see... I see... (gulps) things. Horrors beyond my comprehension. Twisted, eldritch creatures lurking just beyond the veil of reality. They're watching me, waiting for me to succumb to the abyss.

Finley's voice rises to a fevered pitch as the eclipse reaches its peak.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(panicked)
What's happening to me? Why am I being pulled into this... this... (gulps) this abyss? Is this what it means to be... to be... (stammers) to be human?

Jen looks on, concerned, but Finley's gaze is fixed on the void.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(desperate)
I don't want to see this! I don't want to know! But I'm being forced to confront... to confront... (gulps) the abyssal horrors that lurk beyond the veil!

As the eclipse reaches its climax, Finley's voice drops to a whisper.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I am but a small, insignificant fish, and yet... and yet... I am being pulled into a world beyond my comprehension. A world where the laws of reality no longer apply. A world where... where... (gulps) where the very fabric of existence is torn asunder.

The eclipse ends, and the sun reappears. Finley's gaze remains fixed on the void, his mind shattered by the horrors he's witnessed.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I am no longer a fish. I am no longer a creature of the sea. I am... I am... (gulps) I am a vessel for the abyssal horrors that lurk beyond the veil.

Jen looks on, concerned, but Finley's eyes are black as coal, and his gaze is fixed on the void.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - LATER

Finley lies on the sand, his eyes fixed on the horizon. Jen approaches him, but Finley doesn't respond. He's lost in his own world, tormented by the horrors he's witnessed.

JEN
(concerned)
Finley? Finley, are you okay?

Finley's gaze remains fixed on the horizon, his mind shattered by the abyssal horrors he's witnessed.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - LATER

Finley's body begins to contort and twist, his scales turning a sickly shade of green. His eyes glow with an otherworldly energy as he begins to speak in a voice that's no longer his own.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(in a voice that's not his own)
I am the vessel. I am the doorway. I am the abyssal horror that lurks beyond the veil.

The camera zooms out as Finley's body continues to twist and contort, his mind consumed by the horrors he's witnessed.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - LATER

The camera pans out to reveal a desolate, post-apocalyptic landscape. The sky is a deep, foreboding purple, and the air is thick with an otherworldly energy.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(in a voice that's not his own)
I am the end of the world. I am the beginning of the abyss. I am the horror that lurks beyond the veil.

The camera zooms out further, revealing a world that's been consumed by the abyssal horrors that Finley witnessed during the eclipse.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
